description: Defines the StackFrame structure and related enums for representing stack frames in a crash processing context, including trust levels, source info, and associated methods.

classes.name: StackFrame
classes.description: Represents a stack frame with information about instruction address, function, source location, module, and trust level.

methods.name: trust_description
methods.description: Returns a string describing how the stack frame was found based on trust level.

methods.name: ReturnAddress
methods.description: Returns the actual return address as saved on the stack or in a register.
